oval.volume: Explore balanced volume at the crown and sides; adjust it to your hair texture and routine.
oval.parting: Try a center part for symmetry or an off-center part for a softer frame.
oval.consideration: An oval outline leaves room for many silhouettes. Hair density, texture and upkeep matter as much as shape.

hairstyles.name: Soft textured crop
hairstyles.description: A short crop with a little movement follows the gentle jaw taper without adding much height.

hairstyles.name: Relaxed taper
hairstyles.description: Keep the sides tidy and leave a flexible, lightly textured top for an easy silhouette.

hairstyles.name: Cheek-skimming bob
hairstyles.description: A rounded bob creates a new horizontal line around the cheek or jaw. Choose the length with your stylist.

hairstyles.name: Shoulder-length layers
hairstyles.description: Gentle layers offer movement around the face without concentrating all the volume in one place.

hairstyles.name: Loose curtain layers
hairstyles.description: A flexible center or off-center part lets medium layers open around the cheekbones.

hairstyles.name: Long flowing layers
hairstyles.description: Start a few face-framing layers below the chin and let your natural texture set the rhythm.

glasses.name: Soft rectangular frames
glasses.description: A defined horizontal edge adds a little structure to a gently curved outline.

glasses.name: Round frames
glasses.description: Rounded lenses echo softer contours; choose a width that fits comfortably at the temples.

glasses.name: Geometric frames
glasses.description: A subtle hexagonal or angular rim can make the glasses the focal point of your look.

round.volume: If you want a longer-looking silhouette, experiment with a little height at the crown and less width at cheek level.
round.parting: An off-center or side part can add a diagonal line. A center part with longer layers is another option.
round.consideration: Contrast is optional. A rounded cut can be just as expressive if you enjoy a soft, cohesive look.

hairstyles.name: Lifted textured pixie
hairstyles.description: A softly lifted top introduces height while textured edges keep the cut relaxed.

hairstyles.name: Low-maintenance quiff
hairstyles.description: A modest rise at the front adds vertical movement without requiring a dramatic high-volume style.

hairstyles.name: Asymmetric crop
hairstyles.description: A lightly side-swept fringe introduces a diagonal line around a rounded outline.

hairstyles.name: Collarbone-length lob
hairstyles.description: A length below the chin with gentle front layers creates a longer frame around the face.

hairstyles.name: Airy layered shag
hairstyles.description: Keep movement at the crown and ends, with lighter layers around the widest part of the cheeks.

hairstyles.name: Long face-framing layers
hairstyles.description: Longer front pieces create vertical lines while leaving plenty of room for curls or waves.

glasses.name: Rectangular frames
glasses.description: Straighter edges create contrast with a rounded facial outline.

glasses.name: Angular geometric frames
glasses.description: A defined bridge and angled rims introduce structure without needing a heavy frame.

glasses.name: Subtle upswept frames
glasses.description: A gentle lift at the outer corners gives a directional line across the upper face.

square.volume: Soft movement around the temples and jaw can contrast with defined lower-face angles.
square.parting: A relaxed side part introduces asymmetry. A center part with soft waves can frame the jaw without hiding it.
square.consideration: You can soften your outline or emphasize it with a precise cut. Neither approach is more correct.

hairstyles.name: Rounded textured crop
hairstyles.description: Soft edges and an unstructured fringe contrast with a more angular jaw.

hairstyles.name: Scissor taper
hairstyles.description: A gradual scissor-cut transition keeps the sides natural rather than sharply boxed.

hairstyles.name: Soft graduated bob
hairstyles.description: A lightly graduated shape with movement at the ends can sit just above or below the jaw.

hairstyles.name: Shoulder-length waves
hairstyles.description: Loose waves and flexible layers introduce curved lines around the cheek and jaw.

hairstyles.name: Medium side sweep
hairstyles.description: A longer swept top and natural sides bring a diagonal element to a structured outline.

hairstyles.name: Long feathered layers
hairstyles.description: Light layers beginning below the cheekbones add movement while keeping the length you enjoy.

glasses.name: Round metal frames
glasses.description: Curved rims offer a clear contrast to defined jaw angles.

glasses.name: Oval frames
glasses.description: A gently elongated oval introduces softness without adding much frame depth.

glasses.name: Soft aviator frames
glasses.description: A thin rim and curved lower lens can balance a more structured lower face.

heart.volume: Try movement near the jaw or ends if you want to add visual width lower down.
heart.parting: A relaxed off-center part or side-swept fringe can create a softer transition across the upper face.
heart.consideration: Upper-face width is an estimate, not a hairline measurement. Choose styles around your real hair growth pattern.

hairstyles.name: Side-swept pixie
hairstyles.description: A gentle side fringe softens the upper outline while a textured finish keeps the cut light.

hairstyles.name: Natural fringe crop
hairstyles.description: Keep some softness through the fringe rather than concentrating all the height at the front.

hairstyles.name: Jaw-length bob
hairstyles.description: A bob with softly turned ends draws attention to the jaw and adds width around the lower face.

hairstyles.name: Collarbone waves
hairstyles.description: Let volume build toward the ends, with relaxed waves around the chin and shoulders.

hairstyles.name: Long curtain fringe
hairstyles.description: Longer front pieces frame the temples and blend into easy medium-length layers.

hairstyles.name: Long layers with full ends
hairstyles.description: Keep some weight at the ends and add face-framing movement below the cheeks.

glasses.name: Light oval frames
glasses.description: A light rim and curved lenses create a gentle transition from the upper face.

glasses.name: Rounded lower rims
glasses.description: A frame with a rounded, slightly deeper lower half can echo and balance the chin taper.

glasses.name: Fine-rim aviators
glasses.description: A thin teardrop silhouette adds shape lower down without a heavy top line.

diamond.volume: Soft width near the temples or jaw can balance a cheekbone-led outline when that is your styling goal.
diamond.parting: Try a side part or airy curtain fringe to frame a narrower upper face.
diamond.consideration: Avoid hiding features you enjoy. Slicked-back styles can deliberately highlight cheekbones, too.

hairstyles.name: Airy fringe crop
hairstyles.description: A light fringe adds texture near the temples while leaving the cheekbones visible.

hairstyles.name: Soft side-part taper
hairstyles.description: Leave a little width at the sides instead of taking them extremely close to the scalp.

hairstyles.name: Chin-length textured bob
hairstyles.description: Soft ends near the chin introduce movement below the widest cheekbone region.

hairstyles.name: Curtain-fringe shag
hairstyles.description: Airy front layers open around the temples, with relaxed movement through the ends.

hairstyles.name: Medium brushed-back layers
hairstyles.description: Keep some texture at the sides for a softer silhouette while showing your cheekbones.

hairstyles.name: Long waves with curtain layers
hairstyles.description: Soft front sections frame the upper face and blend into waves below the jaw.

glasses.name: Gentle cat-eye frames
glasses.description: An upswept upper rim can bring emphasis to the brow and temples.

glasses.name: Oval frames
glasses.description: Soft oval lenses follow the cheekbone area without adding more sharp angles.

glasses.name: Light browline frames
glasses.description: An emphasized top edge shifts attention toward the upper face. Check that the fit clears your cheeks.

oblong.volume: If you want a wider-looking silhouette, try volume at the sides rather than extra height at the crown.
oblong.parting: A fringe, soft side part or loose curtain shape can break up a long vertical line.
oblong.consideration: A longer outline is not something to correct. These ideas simply let you explore different visual proportions.

hairstyles.name: Textured fringe crop
hairstyles.description: A modest fringe and a low crown can make the outline feel more compact.

hairstyles.name: Soft full-sided pixie
hairstyles.description: Leave some softness at the temples instead of adding all the volume on top.

hairstyles.name: Rounded chin-length bob
hairstyles.description: A fuller shape around the jaw creates horizontal movement and an expressive outline.

hairstyles.name: Shoulder-length waves
hairstyles.description: Waves around the sides add width, with a fringe as an optional finishing detail.

hairstyles.name: Medium shag with fringe
hairstyles.description: Keep layers full around the ears and let a loose fringe interrupt the vertical line.

hairstyles.name: Long layers with a soft fringe
hairstyles.description: If you love long hair, side volume and a soft fringe can bring a different balance to the length.

glasses.name: Deeper round frames
glasses.description: More lens depth brings a horizontal visual break across a longer face.

glasses.name: Deep rectangular frames
glasses.description: Choose a frame with comfortable depth rather than a very narrow lens.

glasses.name: Defined browline frames
glasses.description: A visible top rim draws a horizontal line across the upper face.
